title: Arterial Stiffness
subtitle: How arterial stiffness changes with age and what supports healthy function.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for arterial stiffness as a marker of vascular aging and cardiovascular risk. Moderate evidence supports lifestyle and pharmacologic interventions to reduce stiffness. Emerging and uncertain evidence for novel therapies and long-term clinical outcomes.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
